case_scope: United States climate-insurance stress surface for housing wealth

bottom_50_private_wealth_share.note: Stress surface does not score national wealth shares.

middle_40_private_wealth_share.note: Stress surface does not score national wealth shares.

top_1_private_wealth_share.note: Stress surface does not score national wealth shares.

top_0_1_private_wealth_share.note: Stress surface does not score national wealth shares.

public_social_counterweight.note: Residual markets, mitigation grants, FEMA/state programs, and insurance regulation are public counterweights only if they preserve household claimability rather than merely socializing insurer losses.

lower_half_real_floor.note: A homeowner/renter floor cannot pass when insurance, rent pass-through, escrow shocks, and repair financing can outpace household buffers.

early_foothold_open_access.note: First-home entry can be blocked or later reversed by insurance and repair costs.

parent_backed_threshold_dependency.note: Family help may become more necessary to absorb premium, deductible, and repair shocks.

group_person_closure.note: Low-income, elderly, rural, coastal, wildfire, and historically subordinated groups need separate premium/nonrenewal reads.

housing_land_washout.note: Premiums, deductibles, nonrenewals, underinsurance, repair costs, and forced-sale risk can destroy nominal home-equity gains in hazard-exposed markets.

debt_fee_washout.note: Escrow jumps, debt-financed repairs, and lender coverage requirements can cause debt stress.

wealth_to_rule_risk.note: Public backstops and insurer/reinsurer exits can transfer risk to taxpayers while preserving asset values.

ownership_legibility.note: ZIP/county, policy, nonrenewal, deductible, claims, mitigation, and forced-sale data remain too fragmented for a durable certification pass.

climate_insurance_drag.note: Climate-related insurance cost and availability now function as a direct home-equity durability gate, not a background stressor.

digital_intangible_concentration.note: Not central in this stress case.

dynastic_infrastructure_pressure.note: Not central in this stress case.

monetary_asset_price_channel.note: Property-value repricing and credit conditions can amplify climate insurance shocks.

case_notes: Standing blocker for housing-led wealth certification in hazard-exposed markets.

evidence_debt_register.question: ZIP/county premiums, nonrenewals, and deductibles
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect policy-level premium, deductible, nonrenewal, cancellation, FAIR/residual-market, and insurer-withdrawal data by geography and household group.

evidence_debt_register.question: underinsurance and forced-sale incidence
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Link claims shortfalls, repair delays, mortgage delinquency, forced sale, abandonment, and displacement after disasters.

evidence_debt_register.question: renter pass-through and landlord insurance shock
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Measure rent increases, eviction/lease nonrenewal, repair delay, and habitability after landlord insurance or disaster shocks.

evidence_debt_register.question: public backstop distributional incidence
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map state residual insurance, assessments, FEMA, mitigation grants, tax subsidies, and local fiscal exposure by claimant group.

evidence_debt_register.question: mitigation and relocation support by wealth
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Test whether low-wealth households can afford mitigation, retreat, retrofit, or relocation before premiums/claims force exit.

evidence_debt_register.question: mortgage and escrow stress channel
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Link lender insurance requirements, escrow jumps, delinquency, foreclosure, and credit effects.

gate_05_washout_reconcentration.why: Climate-insurance channels can reconcentrate wealth by forcing low-wealth households out while better-capitalized owners absorb shocks or buy distressed property.

gate_02_floor_reality.why: The real floor is blocked in exposed markets until insurance, repairs, rent pass-through, mitigation, relocation, and public-backstop rails protect households before loss.
